name: Review Pagination
summary: Contained review navigation controls with native-link or native-button semantics supplied by the target.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Horizontally contained navigation region, preferably rendered as a labelled nav element.

anatomy.name: list
anatomy.description: Optional semantic list wrapper for the target-supplied controls.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.description: Repeated native anchor for navigation or native button for a target-owned in-place paging strategy.

anatomy.name: ellipsis
anatomy.description: Optional passive omission marker hidden from the control sequence.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible name identifying the navigation as review pagination.

properties.name: controls
properties.description: Target-owned previous, numbered, omitted, and next controls with current and unavailable state.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Touch-sized controls in a horizontally contained sequence.

states.name: hover
states.description: Fine-pointer feedback for an available non-current control.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on a native control.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable native button or target-disabled link presentation.

behavior.name: navigationBoundary
behavior.description: Targets choose links, in-place buttons, URL state, page-window size, cursor versus offset strategy, loading, and focus/result behavior. The neutral component supplies no paging algorithm.

behavior.name: currentPage
behavior.description: Exactly one numbered control is marked current when the selected strategy exposes page numbers.

accessibility: Use a nav element with a specific accessible label for review navigation.
Prefer native links when controls navigate to URLs and native buttons only for a target-owned in-place paging flow.
Expose the current numbered page with aria-current="page".
Give previous and next controls names that include direction and unavailable state.
Do not leave aria-disabled links activatable; omit their href or prevent every input modality according to the selected target pattern.
Keep the control sequence keyboard reachable when it overflows horizontally.

web.notes: Touch targets, horizontal containment, focus, current, disabled, forced-colors, and reduced-motion presentation are implemented.

shopify.notes: A future adapter must choose a provider-compatible pagination strategy and native control semantics.
